headline: IBM (IBM) and Partners Reach Trusted Quantum Breakthroughs Beyond Classical Computing
summary: IBM (NYSE:IBM) and its partners report multiple independent breakthroughs in quantum computing. The company says it has achieved quantum advantage using error mitigated computations that classical systems cannot feasibly reproduce. Collaborations span Algorithmiq, Qedma, RIKEN, BlueQubit, and the University of Chicago, focusing on verification frameworks, logical qubits, and commercial error mitigation.
